description: GFN1-xTB reference data from tblite (Python API, Calculator('GFN1-xTB')).
program: tblite (PyPI wheel); the version of each record is its 'program'

settings.accuracy_note: accuracy 1e-4 gives SCC thresholds 1e-10 Eh (energy) and 2e-9 e (charges)
settings.energy_decomposition_note: parsed from the tblite printout (verbosity 2); 'electronic' includes H0, Coulomb, third order and the electronic free-energy term -TS

geometry_note: Built from internal coordinates in Angstrom (0.529177210903 A/Bohr), centred, then displaced by a seeded uniform random vector of amplitude 0.03 A per component (numpy RandomState(20261114)).
